title: STMR Multi-Type Armored Platoon Simulator
summary: Multi-vehicle tactical simulator simulating three distinct tank classes interoperating in unified platoon and team combat formations.
highlights: Multi-type armored vehicle simulation with synchronized gunner, driver, and commander stations.
Real-time inter-vehicle networking enabling cooperative platoon tactics in shared virtual terrain.
Ballistic trajectory computation, line-of-sight targeting, and damage modeling.
